comment: Opt-in marker: this scenario needs the live semantic MCP server. run.py starts evals/mcp/semantic_server.py over Streamable-HTTP pointed at this fixtures dir, and puts a fake `nxd` on PATH so the query skill's `nxd mcp health` discovers it. Without this the agent can only Read catalog.json and fabricate tool output. dp/rpc_port shape the proxy URL the skill parses: /<dp>/rpcs/<rpc_port>/mcp.
